qa_pairs.question: What types of job statuses are displayed in the job listing section of the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The job listing section shows all jobs that have been started, are currently running, or are pending. Users can filter jobs by various statuses such as OOM, completed, or running.

qa_pairs.question: How can users locate specific jobs within the job management interface?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can search for specific jobs by their job ID or job name using the search functionality located in the top right corner of the job management interface.

qa_pairs.question: What navigation options are available for browsing through multiple pages of jobs?
qa_pairs.answer: There is an option in the bottom right corner of the interface that allows users to quickly navigate between pages by performing multiple jumps.
